channels.checkin_description: Reminders to check in, and news when someone hasn't.
channels.help_alerts_description: When your elder asks for help. Loud on purpose.

offline.banner: You're offline. Nodly will catch up when you're back online.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network_error: Can't reach Nodly right now. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code doesn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.code_used: That code was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.no_family_pin: Your family hasn't set a PIN.
errors.organizer_required: Only the family organizer can do this.
errors.onboarding_required: Finish setting up your profile first.
errors.invalid_timezone: Pick a timezone from the list.
errors.invalid_country: Pick a country from the list.
errors.invalid_phone: That phone number doesn't look right.
errors.device_revoked: This phone was disconnected by your family.
errors.auth_unavailable: Sign-in is having trouble. Please try again soon.
errors.otp_invalid: That code isn't right, or it expired. Try again or get a new code.
errors.config: The app isn't set up to reach Nodly. See docs/SETUP.md.
errors.help_tests_used_up: That’s enough test alerts for today. Try again tomorrow.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{app}}
welcome.tagline: A daily nod that says I'm okay.
welcome.family_hint: For children, grandchildren and anyone who looks out for someone.
welcome.elder: Someone set this up for me
welcome.elder_hint: Your family will show you a code to connect this phone.
welcome.revoked: Your family disconnected this phone. You can set it up again below.
welcome.left: This phone is no longer in elder mode.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We'll email you a code. No password needed.
signIn.not_family: Is this the elder's own phone? Go back

onboarding.title: About you
onboarding.intro: Your family sees your name. Your timezone lets us show times in yours.
onboarding.timezone_hint: Pick where you live. We suggest, but never choose for you.

family.none: You're not in a family yet. Create one, or join with a code someone sent you.
family.no_elders: No elders yet. Add the person you're looking out for.
family.no_elders_yet: Add the person you’re looking out for, then set up their phone.

elderPhone.heading: Their phone
elderPhone.confirm_body: {{name}}'s phone goes back to the welcome screen. You can set it up again with a new code.

addElder.title: Add an elder
addElder.checkin_note: Daily check-in: a reminder at {{remind}}, expected by {{due}}, their time. You can change this later.

pairing.title: Set up {{name}}'s phone
pairing.steps: On {{name}}'s phone, open {{app}}, choose "Someone set this up for me", then scan this code or type it in.

invites.title: Invite family
invites.intro: Anyone with this code can join your family once. It works for 48 hours.
invites.share_message: Join our family on {{app}}. Open {{link}} or enter the code {{code}}.

pin.title: Family PIN
pin.intro: Typing this PIN on an elder's phone takes it out of elder mode. Choose 4 to 8 digits your elder won't guess.
pin.not_set: No family PIN yet. Without one, you disconnect a phone from this app instead.

elder.pair_intro: Ask your family to show you the code on their phone.
elder.camera_why: The camera is only used to read your family's code.
elder.not_a_code: That isn't a Nodly code. Try again.
elder.leave_title: Take this phone out of elder mode
elder.leave_no_pin: Ask your family to disconnect this phone in their {{app}} app.
elder.done_line: {{names}} know you’re okay. See you tomorrow.
elder.marked_line: {{name}} told the family you’re okay. You can still tap.
elder.nudge_line: You haven’t checked in yet today.
elder.nudge_when: If we don’t hear from you by {{time}}, we’ll let {{names}} know.
elder.alerted_line: You hadn’t checked in, so {{names}} were told at {{time}}. They may call you.
elder.alerted_tap: Tap “I’m okay” and they’ll know right away.
elder.connected_line: Tap “I’m okay” once a day and {{names}} will know you’re well. They can send you photos and voice notes here.
elder.thanks_short_body: Your family can see you’re okay today.

checkin.missed_detail: It was due by {{due}}, {{name}}’s time. Everyone in the family was alerted.
checkin.active_title: {{name}} used Nodly today but hasn’t tapped “I’m okay”
checkin.late_title: No check-in yet · it was due at {{due}}
checkin.step_alert: Alert to everyone in the family
checkin.explain_no_phone: Set up {{name}}’s phone to start daily check-ins.
checkin.explain_starts_tomorrow: {{name}}’s phone was set up after today’s {{due}} check-in time, so daily check-ins start tomorrow.
checkin.open_elder: Their phone, settings and test alerts

help.title: Help
help.will_get: {{names}} will get an alert on their phones.
help.call_me: Just ask them to call me
help.sent_line: You’ll see it here as soon as one of them answers.
help.emergency_local: Medical emergency? Call your local emergency number.
help.not_emergency: Nodly is not an emergency service.
help.on_it_line: They saw your alert and are taking care of it. Keep your phone close.
help.on_it_hint: “I’m on it” tells {{name}} and the family you’re handling this.
help.test_explain: Checks that everyone’s phone rings. It’s clearly labelled as a test.
help.test_sent: Test alert sent to everyone in the family.
help.on_it_done_body: The family has been told you’re handling it.

moments.title: Moments
moments.counts_note: One moment a day keeps Nodly Plus free for your family.
moments.leave_ok: You can leave this screen. It finishes in the background.
moments.sent_line: {{name}} will find it on their home screen.
moments.offline_line: It’s saved here and goes out by itself as soon as you’re back online.
moments.not_counting_near_duplicate: Posted. It looks like a photo you’ve shared before, so it doesn’t count for today.
moments.not_counting_late: Posted. It took more than a day to arrive, so it doesn’t count for today.
moments.not_counting_no_family_clock: Posted. Add an elder to your family and daily moments start counting.
moments.rejected_upload_missing: That didn’t arrive. Please share it again.
moments.rejected_not_a_photo: That file isn’t a photo we can show. Try another.
moments.rejected_too_large: That file is too large. Try another.
moments.today_none: Not shared yet. One moment a day keeps Nodly Plus free.
moments.empty: No moments yet. Share the first one.
moments.all_seen_line: Your family will send more soon.
moments.elder_share: Take a photo for your family
moments.family_sent: Your family sent you {{n}} new moments
moments.camera_denied: Nodly needs the camera to take a photo. You can allow it in Settings.
moments.family_sent_one: Your family sent you a new moment
moments.rejected_not_audio: That recording couldn’t be played. Please record it again.
moments.rejected_too_long: That recording is over 5 minutes. Please record a shorter one.
moments.not_counting_too_short: Posted. Voice notes count for today from 10 seconds.
moments.record_hint: Say hello, tell a story, sing a song. Up to 5 minutes.
moments.record_keep_going: Keep going: from 10 seconds it counts for today.
moments.record_long_enough: Long enough to count for today ✓
moments.voice_short_note: Under 10 seconds: it will still be sent, but won’t count for today.
moments.mic_denied: Nodly needs the microphone to record a voice note. You can allow it in Settings.

plus.history_title: {{name}}’s last 30 days are part of Plus
plus.line: Share one moment a day and Plus stays free. Or pick a pass.
plus.share_detail: A photo or a voice note
plus.day_pass_pending: Your moment is on its way. It unlocks today when it arrives.
plus.unavailable: Purchases aren’t available in this build.
plus.never_locked: Check-ins and Help alerts are never locked.
plus.confirming_line: This takes a few seconds. Plus switches on as soon as it’s confirmed.
plus.waiting_line: The store hasn’t confirmed it yet. Plus switches on by itself once it does.
plus.on_moment: Free today and tomorrow: a moment was shared.
plus.month_locked_line: The last 7 days are always free. The whole month comes with Plus.
plus.timeline_empty: Nothing yet. Share a moment or pick a pass to see it here.
plus.report_sent_line: We’ll look into it. You can keep using Nodly as normal.
plus.never_charged_note: We can’t make a purchase “non-refundable” — store rules apply. A Day Pass is used the moment you buy it.
